roles.title: MBA Product Intern - Summer 2027

pay.applies_to: Annualized base by location: Chicago $169,000; Richmond $169,000; McLean $186,000; New York $203,000 (job grade 'Post-Grad Intern, Product Management')

roles.notes: The exact title is 'MBA Product Intern - Summer XXXX'. I found no 'Senior Associate' wording, but the job grade on the posting is 'Post-Grad Intern, Product Management'. Pay is posted as annualized salary; prorated over 10 weeks that's roughly $32.5k-$39k (my arithmetic, not posted). Paid 10 weeks, Jun-Aug 2027. Hybrid, in person at the assigned site. Requires a 2-year MBA finishing by Aug 2028. No visa sponsorship for the internship. Interns are evaluated for the full-time MBA Development Program, starting about a year after the internship. Couldn't fetch the page directly; figures come from search-engine extracts of the posting. Generic Capital One process (Extern guide, not MBA-specific): online assessment, recruiter screen, then Power Day 2-6 weeks after the OA. Forum offer turnaround ranges from about 5 days to over 1 week after Power Day. No source found for MBA offer dates or response windows.
